title: Active Differential
text: Spur or planetary active differential gear, 4 outputs, {Coupling type} sets Torque coupling Ideal pre-loaded; {Active differential type} sets the differential Spur gears, superposition, {Clutch 1 to differential case gear ratio, Ns1} sets the clutch 1-spur gear, {Clutch 2 to differential case gear ratio, Ns2} sets the clutch 2-spur gear ratio, {Three-gang gear inertia, Jgc} sets the rotational inertia .003, {Axle 1 planetary carrier to axle gear ratio, Np1} sets the planetary 1 carrier gear ratio, {Axle 1 sun gear inertia, Js1} sets the planetary 1 sun gear, {Axle 1 carrier inertia, Jc1} sets the planetary 1 carrier, {Axle 1 ring inertia, Jr1} sets the planetary 1 ring gear, {Axle 2 planetary carrier to axle gear ratio, Np2} sets the planetary 2 carrier gear ratio, {Axle 2 sun gear inertia, Js2} sets the planetary 2 sun gear, {Axle 2 carrier inertia, Jc2} sets the planetary 2 carrier, {Axle 2 ring inertia, Jr2} sets the planetary 2 ring gear, {Crown wheel (ring gear) located} sets the crown wheel connection To the left, {Carrier to drive shaft ratio, NC/ND} sets the ratio, {Carrier inertia, Jd} sets the inertia .1, {Carrier damping, bd} sets the damping 1e-3, {Axle 1 inertia, Jw1} sets the inertia .1, {Axle 1 damping, bw1} sets the damping 1e-3, {Axle 2 inertia, Jw2} sets the inertia .1, {Axle 2 damping, bw2} sets the damping 1e-3, {Axle 1 initial velocity, omegaw1o} sets the angular velocity, {Axle 2 initial velocity, omegaw2o} sets the angular velocity, {Effective applied pressure area} sets the pressure area, {Number of disks, Ndisks} sets the torque coupling, {Effective radius, Reff} sets the radius .20, {Nominal preload force, Fc} sets the force, {Friction coefficient vector, mu} sets the friction, {Slip speed vector, dw} sets the angular velocity, {Torque - slip speed matrix, TdPdw} sets the clutch torque, {Clutch pressure vector, pT} sets the clutch pressure breakpoints, {Slip speed vector, dwT} sets the slip speed breakpoints and {Coupling time constant, tauC} sets the constant .01. Values come from the instance.
